info.title: OpenAI generated image content
info.description: The download carried by the opaque URL of an Image. The vendor publishes no fixed download path; /generated-images/{file} is the twin's opaque returned URL, never a path assembled by a client.

get.summary: Read a generated image at the returned URL
get.description: The URL of the generated image. URLs are only valid for 60 minutes after the image has been generated.

404.description: No image available at this URL.
